### Highlights

#### 🎯 Full Valorant Discord Rich Presence
Now Arto RPC natively supports Valorant alongside League of Legends with seamless auto-detection.

- Automatically detects whether League of Legends or Valorant is currently active and connects to Discord RPC instantly.
- Live in-game agent, map, mode, and party status are displayed with high-resolution official CDN artwork and tooltips.
- Match scores and round timers sync automatically during live competitive, unrated, swiftplay, and custom matches.

#### 🎮 Always Active Mode for Valorant
Showcase your favorite Valorant presence on Discord 24/7 without even launching the game.

- Configure any Valorant agent, map, and game mode directly from the Display settings.
- Select elapsed game timer or continuous active status for realistic presence display.
- Switch between League of Legends and Valorant Always Active profiles with a single click.

#### 🎨 Modern Midnight Visual Theme Overhaul
The user interface has been updated with a sleek midnight gaming aesthetic.

- Refreshed color palette featuring deep midnight slate backgrounds with warm amber/gold accents.
- Modernized rounded cards, polished navigation, and refined status badges across all screens.
- Smoother transitions and improved contrast for presence previews and control cards.

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed in-game character resolution when connecting directly from client lockfile and core-game match sessions.
- Corrected status badge states and presence synchronization during rapid game client transitions.
